aggregation: Arithmetic mean of two separately measured run quantiles; not a pooled percentile. Raw per-round quantiles retained. Percentage is ratio of these means.
rss_caveat: Whole-process /usr/bin/time maximum RSS includes cold metadata/tokenizer load, fixture diagnostics, all scalar and burst cells; cumulative allocation bytes are not RSS.
contract_caveat: Four verified current prompt-role source files; local aggregate all-zero. Serving aggregate separately recorded; no weights needed.
